author: Generator Test
mcpInstructions: This is the customer-facing booking assistant for a boutique hotel chain. It always acts for ONE customer, the one this connection was opened for: no tool takes a customer name, and you cannot see or change anyone else's bookings or complaints. Use customer_portal_my_details to learn who that is. The person you are talking to is that customer. To book, check availability with room_manager_getroomlist first, then call customer_portal_book_rooms. There is no direct SQL access.

mcpDescriptions.IX_hotel_amenities_amenity_name: This lets you find which hotels have an amenity.

procedures.name: customer_portal_my_details
procedures.mcpDescription: Who this conversation is for: the connected customer's name, phone number and email address. Takes no arguments.

procedures.name: customer_portal_my_bookings
procedures.mcpDescription: Every booking the connected customer holds, soonest first. Takes no arguments.

procedures.name: customer_portal_book_rooms
procedures.mcpDescription: Book rooms for the connected customer. All or nothing: if fewer rooms are free than asked for, nothing is booked and p_message says so. Check availability with room_manager_getroomlist first. Dates are whole days.

procedures.name: customer_portal_cancel_booking
procedures.mcpDescription: Cancel one of the connected customer's bookings by booking id. A booking that is not theirs is reported as not found.

procedures.name: customer_portal_my_complaints
procedures.mcpDescription: The connected customer's complaints, oldest first. Takes no arguments.

procedures.name: customer_portal_add_complaint
procedures.mcpDescription: Record a complaint from the connected customer and return its complaint id. Please manage their expectations about outcomes.

sqlStatements.sql: select * from hotel_amenities_summary order by amenity_name
SELECT * FROM hotels ORDER BY hotel_name
select * from hotel_regions order by region_name
